purpose: New measurement of documentary information requests in existing actual correspondence; no desired review grade, model performance or representative-user claim.

new_cohort_selection.rule: Use the smallest of the five RAN mailing-list source indexes by total row count; take every indexed message in the most recent complete calendar month preceding the newest archive month, independently of message subject/body. Metadata-only inspection established RAN5 and May 2026 (2605A through 2605E).
new_cohort_selection.why: A complete bounded documentary cohort can be read directly in this session, with all exclusions retained. This is an explicitly convenient single-WG window, not a random sample.

units.denominator: Every indexed message; source-fetch failures, missing files and duplicates are explicit outcomes.
units.classification_unit: One source message; exact request spans identify each substantive request, but counts use messages to avoid inflating compound requests.
units.independence: Messages in the same thread or event are related; no independent-person count or prevalence generalization.
units.authorship: Only newly authored body text. Quoted history, forwarded requests and signatures are excluded from new requests. Raw source body and character offsets bind every included span.

labeling.include_request_rule: Original sender explicitly requests existing factual information/evidence concerning documents, CR revisions, meeting disposition, pack membership, plenary, clause changes, or recorded process status. Declarative updates and requests to approve/comment/submit/revise a document are not lookup demand. An interrogative mark alone is insufficient.
labeling.actual_language_rule: Preserve exact authored request span, including fragments when the sender uses a fragment. No paraphrase may be labeled original. Subject may provide context but cannot manufacture a question.
labeling.operators: Annotate only operations necessary in the original request: anchored lookup, document/revision link, clause history, temporal comparison/latest, set difference, intersection, grouping/count, conjunction, recorded absence. Do not infer set difference merely from a yes/no question or multiple unrelated facts.
labeling.support: Separate whole-request direct support, partial support, outside-resource scope, and unverified. Meeting outcome, email agreement, and administrative upload status are distinct fields. A demand for reasons/discussion cannot be satisfied by an E1-E6 link alone.
labeling.duplicate_rule: Source-identical body messages share a dedup group. Quoted repetitions are not counted as fresh demands. Preserve every indexed row in the exclusion ledger.

adjudication.annotator: Codex session, model-assisted direct reading, not a human user study.
adjudication.pass1: Read all new source-message content; record provisional category and exact evidence.
adjudication.pass2: Re-read every provisional documentary/mixed request against full raw source to reject action-only or quote-only cases, then verify exact offsets/hashes and map only supported fields.
adjudication.ambiguity: Retain ambiguous cases as unverified and show strict counts separately. No favorable resolution to increase coverage.
adjudication.independent_check: Request a second session/agent only if a slot is available; otherwise disclose single-model annotation and avoid agreement claims.

privacy.private_evidence: Source path, original msg_id/detail_url/sender metadata and body span kept in private_evidence artifacts; original files remain read-only.
privacy.public_projection: Only aggregate counts and privacy-screened technical snippets with identity removed, if suitable. Keep source exactness and original metadata private; no public reuse claim.

prior_primary_papers_read.comparison: Uses designed query/operator/scenario coverage; this analysis adds observed correspondence demand and does not relabel designed scenarios as natural questions.
Constructs database-backed analytical questions across operators; this cohort measures actual requests and does not infer executable gold from source text.

success_criteria: A traceable complete-cohort demand/coverage map that can support, refine, or reject workload motivation. Zero directly supported questions is an admissible result. No benchmark items or evaluations will be invented.
